Name: Alpha Glossary
Source: Strategos alpha — command vocabulary for PLAY

Terms.Title: MoveTo
Terms.Body: Order a unit to march to a map cell. Paths use terrain-cost A*. Arm MOVE (M) or right-click empty ground. Hold Shift to append behind the live plan instead of replacing it.

Terms.Title: Engage
Terms.Body: Direct-fire order against a hostile contact. Arm ENGAGE (E) or right-click a red contact. Range and line of sight still matter; this is not artillery.

Terms.Title: Hold / Dig in
Terms.Body: Stay put and prepare. Dig-in takes about two minutes; once prepared, the unit takes half the incoming fire. DIG IN on the palette bridges to the same Hold/Defend path when the unit can dig in.

Terms.Title: Abort plan
Terms.Body: Clear the selected unit's queued orders. Issued as a logged Abort command so replay can reconstruct the cut. Distinct from Hold — Abort means stop and do nothing.

Terms.Title: ORBAT
Terms.Body: Order of battle: the side's unit tree. Formations own subordinates; an order to a formation decomposes one echelon per step. Select from the map or the ORBAT list.

Terms.Title: TTP / drill
Terms.Body: Tactics, techniques, and procedures — coded drills in the DRILLS binder. Readiness gates which drills you may issue. Glossary terms may cite drill codes such as T1.

Terms.Title: AAR (After-Action Review)
Terms.Body: The AAR section of the post-battle card. Three short lines read from the fight just fought: whether a named drill was ordered, how the casualty exchange landed, and whether the objective was held — commentary, not a score.
